text:
Type: striped flatwoven area rug
Use: covering floors, defining a seating area; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, bohemian
Materials: flatwoven cotton-look fibers, nubby stitched weave, three joined panels
Colors: charcoal and beige speckle, soft peach-beige, olive grey, thin green edge line
Shape: rectangular, three wide vertical panels in different tones, slightly offset pieced look, flat and low, nubby texture
Feel: relaxed, crafted, natural, calm
Goes with: light wood, white or grey sofas, green plants; Scandinavian or bohemian living rooms and bedrooms

product.name: SATTRUP
product.description: The rug is hard-wearing and durable because its made of sisal, a natural fibre taken from the agave plant.
